# Career Changer Translator Skill for Muse

Translate your experience into a new industry's language when you switch careers. It maps transferable skills across industries, reframes your achievements into the target field's vocabulary, and builds a compelling "why I'm changing" narrative. Concretely: worked translation tables (teacher → corporate L&D, military → corporate, retail → sales, hospitality → customer success, healthcare → tech), a hybrid/functional resume structure grouped by skill instead of job title, strategies to build bridge experience (volunteering, certifications, freelance projects), and guidance for the industry-switch paths into tech, finance, or healthcare. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the example translations inflate with US-resume-style metrics ("125% of target", "$500K revenue") — impressive, but tailor numbers to what you can actually defend; recruiters in some markets find the tone overcooked. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
